### `query_audit_logs`

**Create Workspace-level audit logs** · `POST /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/auditlogs` · API v3 · 🟡 write

Create Workspace-level audit logs. Only the Workspace owner can create audit logs.

***Note:** This endpoint is only available to Workspaces on our [Enterprise Plan](https://clickup.com/pricing).*

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | number | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |
